scope: Result-free post-expiry reconciliation of already-admitted fixed-route L3 tickets; not public readiness query, no full publication privacy proof
storage_compatibility: Separate ledger and recipient profile; fresh database only; base and terminal profiles reject each other; no migration

objects.control: COSE Ed25519 CountDeliveryTerminal; exact deployment/tenant/recipient/gateway/session/certificates, ticket/operation/sequence/original time window and envelope hash; no result or result envelope
objects.envelope_hash: SHA256 of exact immutable signed result envelope if prepared; empty bytes if no envelope was prepared. Never SHA256 of low-entropy raw count
objects.receipt: COSE Ed25519 CountDeliveryTerminalAck; binds request digest, challenge, control digest, envelope hash, deployment/tenant/ticket/sequence/recipient certificate, outcome and original event_at
objects.signature_domain: existing protocol/version/suite external_aad with separate control and receipt object types

sender_protocol: Trusted driver selects earliest unresolved fixed-route ticket
Check authenticated route is active, signer matches, and trusted sampled time is at or after original expiry
Create one immutable encrypted signed control and commit PREPARED under witness before returning network bytes
Send control over existing mutual TLS/hostname/certificate-pin transport with fresh challenge; send no count or result envelope
Verify pinned recipient signature, all context/digest/challenge bindings and event-time constraints
Persist encrypted request/receipt and CONFIRMED outcome under witness; only then remove this sequence from pending head selection
recipient_protocol: Verify TLS gateway certificate, control signer/domain/closed schema and fixed route
BEGIN IMMEDIATE shared with ordinary result insertion
Observe monotonic trusted time; reject before expiry while retaining clock floor
If matching inbox record exists, validate full original envelope hash and all ticket metadata, return ACCEPTED at its original accepted_at without changing inbox
If matching CLOSED tombstone exists, require identical control and return original closed_at
Otherwise require exact next sequence and durably insert encrypted CLOSED tombstone
Commit before signing/sending terminal receipt; retain tombstone to reject late results and same-sequence replacement
atomicity_argument: Ordinary insertion and closure acquire the same SQLite write transaction. Earlier accepted transaction can finish even if real time passes expiry; close waits and returns ACCEPTED. If close commits first, a future insertion is rejected by persistent ID/sequence fence. A transient absent read is never sufficient to advance the sender.
clock_semantics: accepted_at is the trusted time sampled in the earlier receipt transaction, not a wall-clock commit/arrival deadline. closed_at is sampled in closure transaction at/after expiry. Committed floor rejects subsequent clock rollback.

outcomes.ACCEPTED: existing exact count envelope already persisted; event_at in original [issued_at,expires_at); maps to effective ACKED
outcomes.CLOSED: no inbox record at atomic closure, persistent fence installed; event_at>=expires_at; maps to effective CLOSED
outcomes.conflicts: Different signed outcome or changed event_at cannot rewrite confirmed state; later ordinary ACK contradicting CLOSED is rejected

state_representation: Original delivery_outbox retains QUEUED/READY/ACKED and immutable envelope evidence. Separate delivery_terminal stores PREPARED/CONFIRMED, control, receipt and outcome. delivery_status and joined pending selection derive finality; raw outbox.state alone is not a complete terminal-state view.

retry_and_recovery.lost_control_reply: Retry identical control with fresh challenge; recipient returns original immutable outcome/time
retry_and_recovery.sender_crash_before_prepare_commit: No control returned; retry after recovery
retry_and_recovery.recipient_close_committed_reply_lost: One durable tombstone; no result retransmission
retry_and_recovery.receipt_committed_at_witness_local_lost: Restore same confirmed receipt; no new network send needed
retry_and_recovery.late_ordinary_ack: May coexist only with ACCEPTED at identical original event time; cannot override CLOSED. Both arrival orders and audit enforce consistency.
retry_and_recovery.budget: No refund, no new mechanism run, no new L3, no lifetime extension or free replacement operation

authorization: Root/chain revocation does not prohibit result-free reconciliation of original admitted ticket; current transport route revocation and TLS credential failure still block network use. This is not a fallback for revoked credentials.
metadata_boundary: Control reveals route/ticket/order/time/hash-presence metadata and receipt reveals ACCEPTED/CLOSED. No result bytes is not zero information; no joint network-observation DP proof is claimed.
assumptions: durable nonrollback inbox and closure tombstones
linearizable nonrollback witness for sender state
remaining: Cross-route privacy-domain ordering and complete external observation proof
Termination for operations withheld before L3 admission, cancellation and mixed recipient policies
Recipient disaster recovery, nonrollback evidence and tombstone retention/GC
Production CA/key lifecycle, revoked-route recovery and bounded server resources
Independent CDDL/COSE interoperability, mechanism review, histogram and strong-baseline evaluation
